title: Quenched Spicy Tunisian Chicken Tagine
description: A spicy and creamy Tunisian dish featuring chicken cooked in a flavorful sauce with Appleton rum, served in a banana leaf vessel, perfect for a monsoon evening. This flexitarian-friendly recipe is a twist on traditional tagine.
instructions: Preheat the broiler to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, Appleton rum, onion, garlic, ginger, and harissa.
Add the chicken to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the marinade and place it on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Broil the chicken for 10-12 minutes or until cooked through.
While the chicken is cooking, heat the coconut cream in a saucepan over medium heat.
Stir the coconut cream constantly until it thickens and reduces slightly.
To serve, place a piece of chicken on each banana leaf and spoon some of the coconut cream sauce over the top.
Fold the banana leaves over the chicken to form a packet and serve immediately.
